messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — during qbringup with Q4B-int4 we saw a spike in failure cases on the golden holdout for low-frequency intents (rarity bucket). Need a quick curation sync to bridge the eval signals into sampling changes.
Jin Park: Ack. Do we have an example batch? any logs or small reproducible set? :eyes:
Maya Patel: Pushing a tiny canary set to the test bucket: s3://redwood-curation/canaries/rarity-q4b/2026-03-20.tar.gz
Maya Patel: Quick snippet of failing examples in case helpful:
```
- user: "How do I cancel my corporate subscription?"
- reference: steps with exact billing IDs
- model: hallucinated support contact + wrong step order
```
Oliver Ruiz: Thanks. Wondering whether this is a quantization coverage issue (long tail tokens) or just sampling exposing edge paraphrases.
Tess (labeler): From initial glance a bunch look like rare billing phrasing + account aliasing. We should expand the golden set in the "rare-billing" stratum by ~600 examples and run relabel.
Samir Shah: +1 to expanding rare stratum. Also recommend dedupe threshold loosened for paraphrase hashes — current Jaccard cutoff 0.85 is killing near-duplicates that are legitimately different in billing context.
Maya Patel: Good call. Can we try two small experiments:
1) Add 600 rare-billing examples to golden, prioritize 200 for immediate relabel by Tess.
2) Temporarily set dedupe_jaccard = 0.78 for the rarity sampler, keep normal flow elsewhere.
Jin Park: I can wire that into sampler config. Command I'll run:
```
curationctl apply --sampler rarity --jaccard 0.78 --add-golden s3://redwood-curation/patches/rare-billing-600.json
```
label-bot: Scheduled 200 tasks for Tess (labeler) in "golden-relab" queue. ETA 36h.
Tess (labeler): Got it, will start relabeling the 200 canary tasks tomorrow morning. Will flag ambiguous ones.
Oliver Ruiz: After relabel, can we run the small gold->eval canary against Q4B-int4 and Q-bringup baseline and capture token-level diffs? Need to know if regression is distributional or quant artifact.
Samir Shah: I'll add a per-token diff hook in the eval harness (adds kvcache path and token-ids) and dump to /tmp/q4b-token-diffs. Also will trigger a fallback route if failure rate > 7% on the rare stratum.
Maya Patel: Perfect. Owners: Jin for sampler change, Tess for relabel, Samir for eval hook + fallback rule, Oliver to triage root cause. Check back here when relabel done and I'll schedule a quick postmortem if the regression persists. :thumbsup:
Jin Park: Running the change now, posting status after job completes.
Samir Shah: Eval hook in CI, will run nightly canary and post csv to the canary bucket. If anyone wants a manual run ping me.
Maya Patel: Thanks team. If anything blocks relabel (ambiguous labels), tag me and we'll escalate to product for clarifications.
